broad_core_role: global candidate universe and default order; never counted as an expert

families.label: Functional & Homology
families.context_policy: optional relation-context route; all train-known positives for the query may be seeds, held-out target relations never may

families.label: Structural & Mechanistic
families.support_policy: availability remains metadata; pocket-support features receive no ranking authority after failed relation-clean outer confirmation
families.missing_policy: available scoring members only; silent if none

families.label: Domain Specialists
families.policy: R2E specialists are kept intact in general-category ablation and each contributes only under its frozen applicability gate; the current E2R category surface does not add family-CAGE/TPS specialists.

relation_visibility.known_relation_output_policy: train-known relations for the current query are excluded from discovery output
relation_visibility.seed_context: all train-known positives for the query; zero if none
